description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. The Opportunity The CPO office at Prosus is deliberately small. Nalden sets the direction: what we build and why. Jons, as Chief of Staff, creates the traction: the operating model, the portfolio, the prioritisation, and the decisions that turn direction into shipped product. Around them sit product managers, product marketing, growth, brand, content and design, and three product pods that do the building. What holds those two ends together is the work itself: every initiative visible, owned and moving, and every decision captured before it evaporates. That is this job. As Program Manager you run Nalden_OS — the operating loop of the CPO portfolio — day to day. You do not own the initiatives; you make sure each one has someone who does. You join while that loop is being built rather than maintained, so you shape it: what gets tracked, how reviews run, what a decision record looks like, and which reporting we stop doing because nobody reads it. In this role you will Keep the whole portfolio visible, with an explicit owner on every line of work in flight across the CPO office and the product pods. Prepare the decisions: shape ambiguous work until it is ready to be decided on, and prepare the prioritisation calls and operating reviews for the CPO and the Chief of Staff. Make it move: track progress and dependencies across teams, surface blockers early, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a status update. Make it stick: capture decisions and the reasoning behind them, keep the information people rely on accurate, and turn what teams learn into knowledge someone will reuse. Build the view: a clean, reliable portfolio in slides, backed by a tracking system people actually update — assembled with AI so it takes an hour, not a week. Be the honest signal: say early where the plan and reality have diverged, including when the useful version is the uncomfortable one. What This Role Is Not You do not make product decisions, approve teams' work, or become a reporting layer between teams and leadership. If teams spend more time updating you than shipping, the role is failing — and you would be the first to say so. Who You Are You are the person others trust in a messy week. When priorities shift and work stalls, you stay level, name what is actually happening, and get the loop closed. You follow up without nagging, and an unowned item bothers you until somebody picks it up. You like order, but you fit the system to the work rather than the other way round. You build trust quickly across designers, engineers and executives, and you carry influence without authority: you move work through people who do not report to you. You are direct enough to raise the awkward problem early, and low-ego enough to let someone else take the credit when it lands. What You Bring 8 to 10 years running cross-team program execution in digital commerce, technology product management, consumer facing technology, with an earlier career in management consulting. You have owned outcomes across teams without owning the teams. Titles vary — program manager, strategy manager, operations lead, product operations — but the pattern is the same: you were accountable for work you moved through people who did not report to you. Fluent in product work: you know how discovery, design and shipping actually run, and you can talk to designers and engineers without a translator. Comfortable with data and tools: you build a clean portfolio view and a tracking system people trust, and you use AI to do the assembly faster than most. Experience working closely with senior leaders, ideally from an executive office or chief-of-staff environment; experience inside a larger corporate group around a small, fast team is a real advantage. Comfortable at both altitudes: you can run a room of executives in the morning and fix the tracking sheet in the afternoon. Excellent written and spoken English. Dutch is a plus, not a requirement. Not a classic PMO profile. We want someone who clears the path, not someone who produces process. What We Offer Global Impact: Play a crucial role in shaping the future of global commerce. Be part of a dynamic ecosystem of tech-led companies across markets, from emerging disruptors to established platforms, all working to create positive change at scale. Growth Opportunities: Expand your expertise through high-stakes challenges within our diverse portfolio. You will gain access to a network of businesses, leaders, and learning opportunities that span continents and industries. Innovative Culture: Join a forward-thinking team that values strategic insights and bold ideas. You will operate at the intersection of venture-building, innovation, and investment, where experimentation is encouraged and cross-company collaboration drives breakthroughs. Creative Environment: Engage in work that encourages creativity and constant improvement. We challenge assumptions, explore new frontiers, and believe great ideas can come from anywhere in our ecosystem. Collaborative Atmosphere: Benefit from autonomy and self-management in a supportive, outcome-driven workspace. You will work alongside sharp, motivated peers across our portfolio, all united by a shared ambition to move the needle. Hybrid Work: Experience the satisfaction of our flexible model tailored to balance work and life. Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a salary package that reflects your skills and contributions. Comprehensive Benefits: From health and wellness to learning, commuting, and everyday perks, we offer a well-rounded package designed to help you thrive at work and beyond. Why Prosus? At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next. Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing. Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page. Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have. Want to know more about life at Prosus? Im Umgang mit Reisenden und sicherheitsrelevanten Situationen bist du erfahren Ausgeprägte kommunikative Sensibilität im Umgang mit Mitarbeitenden und Behörden zeichnet dich aus Bei uns zählt der description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d'utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s'impose comme une référence sur le marché français. N2F est une solution complète de gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs), le tout dans une interface simple, intuitive et 100 % connectée (app web et mobile). Portés par une équipe engagée de 230 collaborateurs, qui place l'humain au centre de ses priorités, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles. Être Sales Director Grands Comptes & Secteur Public chez N2JSoft : Tu rejoins notre pôle commercial, sous la responsabilité directe du CRO, et prends la direction commerciale de l'ensemble de nos grands comptes, privés et publics, sur l'ensemble de nos solutions. Ce poste s'inscrit dans notre stratégie de montée en gamme : tu structures une direction commerciale encore à construire, développes les compétences d'une équipe de sept personnes et positionnes N2JSoft comme une plateforme de référence auprès des grandes organisations. Il s'agit d'un poste de management : tu ne gères pas de portefeuille en propre, mais tu interviens aux côtés de tes équipes sur les dossiers à fort enjeu. Tes principales missions : Stratégie commerciale Définir et piloter le plan d'action commercial du périmètre : objectifs, ciblage, priorisation des actions et prévisions de ventes. Construire le go-to-market et le budget de la direction commerciale, en lien avec le CRO. Analyser les évolutions du marché et identifier les opportunités de croissance, en collaboration avec le Marketing et le Produit. Renforcer la visibilité de N2JSoft auprès des grands comptes, des acheteurs publics et des partenaires : appels d'offres, salons, conférences et événements professionnels. Management et développement de l'équipe Encadrer une équipe de sept personnes (commerciaux, avant-vente), la fédérer autour d'une stratégie commune et accompagner leur montée en compétence. Organiser l'activité commerciale et instaurer des rituels de pilotage : suivi du pipeline, prévisions, revues de performance. Évaluer la performance individuelle et collective à partir d'indicateurs partagés, et engager les actions correctives nécessaires. Accompagnement des ventes complexes Intervenir en appui des commerciaux sur les dossiers stratégiques, notamment lors des phases de négociation. Représenter N2JSoft auprès des décideurs des grandes organisations privées et publiques. Profil recherché : Tu as une expérience confirmée du management d'une équipe commerciale, avec une posture à la fois stratégique et opérationnelle. Tu as développé des grands comptes et/ou le secteur public, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS B2B ou dans la vente de services complexes. Tu sais construire un plan d'action commercial et en démontrer les résultats chiffrés. Tu as déjà accompagné une équipe dans sa montée en compétence et dans une phase de transformation. Tu fais preuve de leadership et tu sais embarquer des interlocuteurs multiples, en interne comme chez nos clients. Tu as le sens du résultat, de l'organisation et une réelle curiosité. Tu as un niveau d’anglais professionnel. C'est un plus si tu connais l'univers du spend management. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un poste à fortes responsabilités, très visible, au cœur de notre stratégie de montée en gamme. Une direction commerciale à structurer, avec un impact direct sur notre croissance. Une proximité avec la direction et des décisions rapides. Une entreprise rentable, en croissance, avec une forte ambition européenne. Une équipe bienveillante et passionnée. Les avantages chez N2JSoft : Voiture de fonction, Prime de vacances, Chèques cadeaux à Noël, Chèques rentrée scolaire (si tu as des enfants), Chèque culture, Cours de musique, Événements d'équipe toute l'année. description: À propos de Lexroom Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. Chaque source est minutieusement analysée, les liens implicites entre principes sont identifiés, et toutes les informations sont synthétisées dans un rapport structuré, avec chaque affirmation soigneusement sourcée. Ce qui, auparavant, demandait une semaine à une équipe se réalise désormais pendant une pause café. Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, afin que les avocats et les directions juridiques puissent se concentrer sur l'essentiel. Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale en France, et nous cherchons la personne qui va la former, l'accompagner et la faire monter en compétence à travers la Lexroom Sales Academy. Pourquoi rejoindre Lexroom ? Un produit qui tient ses promesses : nos démos sont impactantes et convainquent dès la première session, pas besoin de six mois de POC. Un marché en pleine effervescence : tous les cabinets français recherchent une solution IA, et les usages sont encore à inventer. Das solltest du mitbringen Langjährige Erfahrung als Architekt:in oder Senior Engineer, idealerweise bei einem Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1+) und konversationssicheres Englisch. Das haben wir zu bieten Kompetitive Vergütung: Attraktives, marktgerechtes Gehaltspaket, das zu Deiner Erfahrung und Kompetenz passt. Echte Produktionsverantwortung: Deine Systeme laufen produktiv bei großen Unternehmensgruppen - nicht in der Demo-Umgebung. Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt. Kein 08/15: Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use Cases und Technologien - vom GPU-Cluster bis zum Voice-Agenten. Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: Wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden. Mache einen Unterschied: Viel Verantwortung, großer Gestaltungsspielraum - in einem Mittelständler, in dem dein Beitrag den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg direkt beeinflusst. Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche. Wie arbeiten selbstorganisiert: Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden. Werde berühmt: Eine technische Redaktion unterstützt dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst. Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Echte Sparring-Partner, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln. Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet Erreichbarkeit nach Feierabend, im Urlaub oder trotz Krankmeldung. Viele Überstunden sind bei uns nicht üblich. Gut für die Psyche: Ersthelfer psychische Gesundheit, Employee Assistance Programm und ein offener Umgang mit mentaler Gesundheit. Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei, Arbeiten aus dem EU-Ausland, Sabbatical oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück. Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen. description: We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster. We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo. We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer, Finance at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year. Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that. WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE IN THIS ROLE You will be the primary technical owner of Finance's data architecture, models and pipelines, building the infrastructure behind financial reporting, analytics and decision-making across the business. You'll sit within Finance, with a dotted-line relationship to our VP Data & AI, working where Finance, Data and Engineering meet. You'll have real autonomy to design and build scalable solutions, while staying aligned with our wider data architecture and engineering standards. Our core stack includes NetSuite, Fivetran, Snowflake and dbt, alongside internal operational platforms and external financial data sources. As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the things you could be getting involved in: Own the design and development of Finance's data architecture and models, creating a single, trusted source of truth for financial reporting and analysis. Build and maintain automated pipelines and transformations across NetSuite, Snowflake, dbt and our operational systems. Develop scalable datasets covering revenue, costs, margins, receivables, collections and cash flow, giving FP&A, Accounting and Treasury self-serve access to data they can trust. Establish automated reconciliations, validation and monitoring so financial information is accurate, complete and auditable. Automate the data infrastructure behind collection curves, portfolio analytics, cash forecasting and lender reporting. Eliminate manual data preparation and spreadsheet-based workflows across Finance. Apply engineering best practices, including automated testing, version control, documentation and monitoring. Partner with Finance stakeholders and the central Data team to turn business requirements into practical technical solutions. WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value: Strong experience in analytics engineering, data engineering or a similar technical role, with the ability to independently design, build and maintain production data solutions. Advanced SQL and experience developing complex data models and transformations. Hands-on experience with cloud data warehouses (ideally Snowflake) and dbt or similar transformation frameworks. Experience building automated data pipelines, validation and controls that keep information consistent across systems. Strong communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strongly preferred: Experience working with financial, accounting or transactional data, including how information flows between operational systems, financial systems and reporting. Understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting and reconciliations. Nice to have: Experience with NetSuite, Fivetran or similar ERP and integration platforms. Python for data processing and automation. Background in receivables, collections, lending or other transaction-heavy businesses. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Finance operates from a single, trusted source of financial data. Financial and operational datasets reconcile consistently across systems. Core reporting runs on reliable, automated pipelines. Manual data preparation and reconciliation work is significantly reduced. Finance has the data infrastructure it needs to keep scaling with the business. WHAT WE OFFER We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to join our Cloud Monetization Platform team in Amsterdam or remotely.

Our platform powers the commercial foundation of Nebius Cloud. Every GPU hour, storage operation, network transfer, reservation, enterprise contract, or customer payment flows through the systems we build before becoming revenue.

Unlike traditional billing systems, our platform combines several challenging engineering domains. You'll design clean abstractions for a rapidly evolving business model, build reliable distributed workflows where correctness and consistency are as important as performance, and help shape a modern platform from the ground up.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • Strong knowledge of Python or willingness to quickly become productive with our technology stack

  • Experience building distributed backend systems and microservice architectures

  • Understanding of distributed transactions, consistency models, and reliable asynchronous workflows

  • Experience designing scalable backend services

  • Strong communication and ownership mindset

It would be an added bonus if you had experience building Billing, payments or pricing systems

Technology stack:

  • Python, gRPC, Temporal, YDB, Kafka-like messaging, Kubernetes, 25+ microservices.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Data, AI, Solutions and Engineering practice are looking for experienced Senior Consultants, Managers and Senior Managers to join the team. 

Insight is changing quickly. Static dashboards and periodic reporting are increasingly being complemented by conversational analytics, embedded insight, AI-enabled applications and agents. The opportunity is not simply to produce more insight. It is to help organisations create measurable value by improving the decisions and actions that shape performance. 

We are looking for Decision & Insight Leads who can work at the intersection of business, data and technology. You will start with strategic and operational outcomes, understand the decisions and behaviours that drive them, explore the available data, and shape an insight capability that people will actually use. The answer might be a redesigned KPI framework, semantic model, dashboard, analytical application, conversational experience, agent, or a combination of these. 

This is a technically grounded analytics role, not a non-technical business analysis role. You will be comfortable analysing data and building meaningful elements of analytical solutions yourself, while also being able to frame value, shape the wider solution and lead multidisciplinary delivery. At more senior grades, your personal build time may reduce, but your judgement should remain rooted in genuine analytical and technical depth being able to architect these solutions. 

What you will be doing

  • Understand the strategic and operational outcomes a client is trying to achieve, identify the decisions and behaviours that drive them, and define how better insight can unlock measurable value. 
  • Frame ambiguous business problems as clear analytical and decision problems, connecting objectives to decision journeys, KPI/value trees, use cases, measures of success and prioritised delivery backlogs. 
  • Explore and analyse data directly to test hypotheses, understand patterns and data quality, challenge assumptions and establish what is feasible. 
  • Shape and, where appropriate, build the insight and decision architecture: what should be standardised through data and semantic models, what should be surfaced through visualisation or conversational interfaces, and where insight should be embedded directly into operational workflows. 
  • Design analytical experiences, including wireframes and human-AI interactions, that help people understand, trust and act on insight. 
  • Work in and, with experience, lead mixed teams of Baringa colleagues, client teams and technology specialists from discovery and analysis through build, deployment, adoption and value realisation. 
  • Contribute hands-on to analytical solution delivery, while providing technically informed leadership and challenge across solution design, data, analytics and AI choices. 
  • Ensure solutions are usable, trusted, governed and embedded into the way an organisation works, rather than stopping at a prototype, report or technical artefact. 
  • Build lasting client capability through coaching, pairing, knowledge transfer and reusable approaches, so clients can continue to evolve their insight capability after the engagement.  

Your skills and experience  

You might describe yourself today as an analytics consultant, technical business or data analyst, insight transformation lead, analytical product owner, BI / analytics lead, or something else entirely. Whatever your current title, you will be an analytically strong, technically grounded practitioner who knows how to turn data and technology into better business decisions. 

  • Excellent analytical and data literacy, with the ability to interrogate data yourself, structure analysis, test hypotheses and translate findings into clear business implications. 
  • Deep experience shaping, building and deploying analytical solutions into real business environments, rather than only defining requirements or managing delivery. 
  • Strong hands-on grounding in the core analytics toolkit, likely including SQL and tools such as Power BI or Tableau, together with Python or comparable modern analytical technologies. You do not need to be a specialist engineer, but you should be able to build meaningful elements of an analytical solution yourself. 
  • Strong understanding of KPI and metric design, analytical and semantic modelling, and the shared definitions and architecture needed to create trusted, reusable insight in an explainable manner to business leaders. 
  • A robust grounding in how AI is changing analytics, with hands-on experience of capabilities such as conversational analytics, generative BI, LLM-enabled insight or agents. We do not expect everyone to have deployed these technologies extensively at enterprise scale, but we do expect experimentation, practical build experience and informed judgement about where they create value. 
  • Experience designing how people consume and act on insight, from dashboards and analytical applications through to embedded and conversational experiences, with an appreciation of human-AI interface design and where human judgement matters. 
  • Strong business problem-solving, with the ability to connect strategic and operational outcomes to decisions, measures, data and analytical interventions. 
  • Strong communication and consulting skills, including working across business and technical stakeholders and, at the relevant grade, leading workstreams, mixed teams and senior client relationships. 
  • Genuine curiosity about the changing analytics and AI landscape, with evidence that you actively experiment, learn and develop your skills as technology evolves. 

You may also bring 

  • Deeper expertise in Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake or comparable modern analytics platforms, including their architecture, governance, and enterprise deployment. 
  • Deeper expertise in integrating AI capabilities into BI and analytics platforms. 
  • Product ownership, service design, UX / wireframing or agile product delivery experience. 
  • Predictive analytics, optimisation, simulation or digital twin experience. 
  • Deeper solution architecture, software engineering or data engineering capability. 
  • Deep knowledge of one or more sectors such as Energy & Resources, Financial Services, Government or Products & Services. 

How the opportunity flexes with experience 

At Senior Consultant level, we expect strong hands-on analytical delivery and growing ownership of workstreams, solution design and client relationships. At Manager level, the emphasis grows toward shaping solutions, leading mixed teams and owning delivery and value outcomes while retaining meaningful technical involvement. At Senior Manager level, we expect leadership of complex, ambiguous client problems, senior relationships, proposition and market contribution, and the technical credibility to define an insight architecture, set direction and bring the right specialists together.  

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

 

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. For more information, please contact us at For the USA

Your personal data may be retained by Baringa for up to two years, as outlined in our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to support the recruitment process and internal reporting requirements. Where applicable, and in accordance with relevant federal and state laws, you may have the right to request access to or correction of your personal information. For further details, please contact For Australia & Singapore

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to assess your application and meet applicable reporting and legal obligations. In line with the Australian Privacy Act and Singapore’s Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA), you may have rights to access, correct, or request limited deletion of your personal data. ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About the team 

Tide is the leading business financial platform founded in the UK, empowering over 1 million small businesses to grow and succeed. Now expanding in France, Tide offers innovative financial tools and services to micro-entrepreneurs, freelancers, independent professionals (professions libérales) and small and medium-sized businesses (TPE/PME). Our mission is to save business owners time and money, enabling them to focus on what they do best - running their business.

You’ll be joining a dedicated and dynamic team in Paris focused on driving Tide’s market success in France. The Tide France team is in an exciting growth phase, bringing together professionals with deep expertise in fintech, product development and French market dynamics. As part of this expanding team, you’ll have the unique opportunity to shape Tide’s presence in France, working collaboratively to deliver innovative solutions for French small business owners. This is your chance to play a pivotal role in establishing the foundation for our long-term success in this key market.

About the role 

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Country Commercial Manager, based in Paris, to drive the growth of Tide’s business accounts and payment solutions in France. In this pivotal role, you will lead product growth initiatives, leveraging analytics, customer insights, and market trends to position Tide as a leading financial partner for small businesses in France.

As the Senior Country Commercial Manager, you will have accountability for French revenues, working closely with our Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams. Reporting directly to the Country Managing Director France, your expertise in the French market, SME customer behaviour and regulatory landscape (ACPR, PSD2, the e-invoicing reform) will be instrumental in shaping Tide’s offering and driving strategic growth.

Some of the things you’ll be doing:

  • Revenue Ownership: Take ownership for driving revenue growth across product lines in France. Develop and execute strategies to meet revenue targets, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between product offerings, pricing, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Local Market Expertise: Collaborate with the product research teams to conduct French market research to uncover customer needs, analyse a competitive landscape of neobanks and traditional banks, and identify market opportunities, such as the e-invoicing mandate (facturation électronique) rolling out from September 2026. Translate these insights into actionable strategies to enhance Tide’s product offerings.
  • Product Localization and Development: Collaborate with global product managers to design and launch products tailored to the French market, reflecting local payment habits, invoicing and accounting workflows. Lead initiatives to ensure local relevance and compliance with French and EU requirements, while maintaining alignment with Tide’s global vision.
  • Marketing and Sales Strategy: Work with regional marketing teams to develop and refine marketing and sales strategies for marketing the products in the French market, including partnerships with key SME channels such as accountants (experts-comptables) and the entrepreneur ecosystem (Bpifrance, CCI, incubators). Monitor performance metrics and adapt plans to ensure we meet and exceed growth targets.
  • Content and Collateral Creation: Support creation of high-quality marketing and customer-facing materials in French, ensuring they comply with French regulations (including ACPR rules on commercial practices) and resonate with local audiences.
  • Operational Readiness and Go-Live Support: Partner with the Operations team to ensure seamless product launches, from final QA testing to internal training and ongoing support for new features.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the central point of contact between Tide’s global teams and the Paris team, driving alignment and ensuring projects are delivered efficiently.

What we are looking for 

  • You have 7+ years' relevant experience ideally within the SME, SaaS, or fintech industries in France. Experience with banking or payment solutions for French SMEs is highly desirable.
  • You are fluent in French (native or near-native) and professional English, as you’ll work daily with French customers and partners and with Tide’s global teams.
  • You know the French SME ecosystem well (micro-entrepreneurs, TPE/PME, accountants, banking and payment players) and its regulatory environment.
  • You excel at developing and executing commercial strategies that deliver measurable business impact. You’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves and remove blockers.
  • You have very strong project management skills and can foster collaboration with teams outside of your direct control by building strong relationships.
  • You’re well versed in product analytics, and can use data to drive decisions within product marketing campaigns and follow it up with actions to constantly improve on product acquisition and engagement  goals.
  • You’ve worked across multiple markets, navigating the complexities of global product development with a keen understanding of localization requirements.
  • You’re comfortable working in a fast-moving company where priorities can change and processes may need to be created from scratch.
  • You’re a self-starter who doesn’t wait for instruction, and who works backwards from targets to ensure effective execution.

What you’ll get in return: 

  • 25 days of paid leave per year (congés payés)
  • Additional 3 days of paid leave for volunteering or L&D
  • We invest in your development with a professional L&D budget
  • Complementary health insurance (mutuelle) and disability and life cover (prévoyance)
  • Statutory pension contributions (basic and Agirc-Arrco complementary pension)
  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport pass (e.g. Navigo)
  • Extended Parental Leave
  • Mental health support through Plumm
  • A one-off home office budget
  • Work and travel globally - up to 90 days per country outside of your home country
  • Team socials 
  • Sabbatical Leave 

Tidean Ways of Working

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices, including our Paris office, are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Senior Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data. 

You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.
  • Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.
  • Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.
  • Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes.
  • Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.
  • Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.

About you 

  • Extensive proven working experience as a Decision Scientist, Data Analyst, Data Scientist or a related position.
  • Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.
  • Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.
  • Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.
  • Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.
  • Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.
  • Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maneuver Dominance team in London builds the Mission System and Autonomy for Anduril's autonomous air platforms. Aircraft built to operate alongside crewed aviation and deliver effects in contested environments.

Hardware is where the mission system meets the airframe. Our sensors, payloads, stores, compute and radios have to share power, space and cooling on a compact aircraft, survive heat, vibration and interference, and still be ready to fly in months, not years. Boards that work first time, and that are easy to build, test and fix, are what keep the whole system moving. That is the problem you would own.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to join us in London and own electronic hardware across our mission system and payloads. This is a full-cycle role. You will take customer needs and mission parameters, turn them into measurable requirements, and carry the design through schematic, layout, bring-up, qualification and integration on the aircraft. That includes boards that form part of the Stores Management System, where the interface to the weapon has to be right first time. You will be the voice for electrical design in vehicle-level trade studies, and you will be in the lab and at the test range when the hardware needs debugging.

We are looking for someone who sees the whole system, not just the board: low-ego and high-ownership, mission focused, and able to justify a design decision to engineers and to leadership alike. This is a full-time, on-site role, because the work is hands-on and the team learns from each other at the bench.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own the development of electronic hardware for payloads and subsystems across the Mission System, including sensor interfaces, power management, compute and networking
  • Turn customer asks and mission parameters into quantifiable hardware requirements, and create architectures and designs that meet them
  • Deliver full-cycle PCB design: requirements capture, schematic design, component selection, layout (completing it or supervising it), bring-up, test, debug, qualification and system integration
  • Design mixed-signal boards that combine high-speed digital, precision analogue, RF and high-power circuits, including microcontroller and processor based designs
  • Perform power design and electrical loading analysis, and develop power management and distribution for payloads and subsystems
  • Design, test and qualify boards for the Stores Management System, including MIL-STD-1553 data bus and MIL-STD-1760 aircraft-to-store interfaces, and safety-critical circuits such as release consent, arming and interlocks
  • Develop system interconnect diagrams and define the wire harnesses that connect equipment within a subsystem and onto the air vehicle
  • Design for manufacture, test and the operating environment from the start, applying IPC standards and accounting for temperature, vibration and EMI
  • Troubleshoot issues that span the electrical and software boundaries, using lab equipment and basic software debugging tools
  • Conduct peer-level and cross-discipline design reviews, and represent electrical design at Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), Critical Design Reviews (CDR) and Test Readiness Reviews (TRR)
  • Collaborate closely with mechanical, RF, software, firmware, systems and test engineers to deliver fully functional, mission-critical products
  • Establish and refine team processes for PCB design, design for manufacturing (DFM), part creation and library standards
  • Support integration, ground and flight test of prototype and production representative hardware, across multiple concurrent projects and customers

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of hands-on industry experience designing, testing and troubleshooting complex board-level electronic hardware
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Full-cycle PCB design experience, from requirements capture through schematic, layout, bring-up, qualification and sustainment
  • Experience designing mixed-signal, multi-layer PCBs, including stack-up, impedance control, grounding, protection and filtering for power and sensor applications
  • Experience with power design, power management and electrical loading analysis, and with designing and integrating high-power electronics
  • Hands-on experience with microcontrollers and processors, including bring-up, and familiarity with common MCU, CPU and FPGA devices
  • Familiarity with common interfaces such as Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, PCIe, USB, RS-232, RS-422 and RS-485
  • Fluency with lab test equipment: oscilloscopes, DMMs, logic and spectrum analysers, bench power supplies, electronic loads and current probes, plus experience automating tests
  • Experience using Altium Designer (other ECAD tools considered), including component library development and management
  • Working knowledge of the relevant IPC standards for design, fabrication and assembly
  • Experience with rapid payload or sensor integration into air vehicles, UAVs, ground vehicles or weapons systems
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, and the habit of documenting a design as it develops
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active UKSV Security Clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience designing electrical and power systems for UAS or rotorcraft
  • Design and test experience against MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810 and DO-160, or UK equivalents such as Def Stan 59-411 and Def Stan 00-35
  • A comprehensive understanding of the effects of temperature, shock and vibration on electronics, and of designing for rugged environments
  • A strong background in one or more of the following: radios and RF systems; radar or optical sensors (EO/LWIR/MWIR/SWIR); gimbals and electro-mechanical or actuator systems; SIGINT/ELINT/EW/ESM systems; tactical data links and encryption
  • Experience designing hardware for MIL-STD-1553 data bus and MIL-STD-1760 aircraft-to-store interfaces, ideally as part of a Stores Management System
  • Experience with stores, weapons or launched effects integration, including weapon safety assurance
  • Experience developing low-level firmware for bring-up and test
  • Experience with power systems, including batteries
  • IPC CID or CID+ certification
  • Experience taking hardware from prototype to production at a fast-paced aerospace, defence or vehicle company

We're looking for an Engineering Manager with a strong mobile focus. description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building laser-driven inertial fusion as a commercial source of clean power. Our $240M Series A is the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, and we are using it to grow teams in Germany and the US at the same time. Your Role As the Senior HR Business Partner, you will be the People partner for our Engineering department, one of the fastest growing parts of the company. It brings together mechanical, electrical, hardware and other engineering disciplines, led by people who are hiring faster than their structures can keep up. Many of them are leading at this scale for the first time. They do not need HR explained to them. They need someone who understands what their team is trying to deliver and helps them decide how to organize, grow and lead it. This year we ran our first formal performance review and introduced a career framework. Both are in place and neither is finished. You will take what exists and make it hold as the company grows: calibration that leaders trust, levels that mean the same thing in Darmstadt and in Austin, promotion decisions that can be explained to the person who did not get one. You will have room to do that work. People Operations runs contracts, payroll and HR administration. Talent Acquisition runs hiring. You join a team of Business Partners, and your time goes into partnering and building. A background in fusion is not required. We expect you to want to learn how the business works, because your advice is only as good as your understanding of it. *This position is based in Darmstadt and requires onsite presence three days a week. This role reports to the Director People. German and English fluency are required. What you will own in your first year The people agenda for your client groups. How the teams are structured, where the next leaders come from, and which roles the business cannot afford to lose. The next performance and calibration cycle in your areas, from manager preparation through to the conversations that follow. The career framework for the business areas you support. Our company-wide framework sets the levels and the principles. You build the specific version underneath it with your leaders, so that a mechanical engineer and an electrical engineer can each see what growth looks like in their own discipline. Manager capability in your groups. By the end of the year, your leaders set clearer expectations and have the difficult conversation earlier than they do today. What You'll Do Most weeks start with a leader and a problem that is not yet well defined. A team that has doubled and stopped delivering. A strong engineer who is struggling as a manager. Two groups that both believe they own the same work. You ask enough questions to find what is underneath, bring options with a recommendation, and stay with the decision until it has landed. Alongside that you will: Coach managers on expectations, direct feedback and conversations they would rather postpone. Handle employee relations cases with care and sound judgment, within German employment law. Work with Talent Acquisition on hiring priorities and with People Operations on everything from contract type to exit, so leaders get one joined-up answer. Use people data to show leaders what is happening in their teams and what you would do about it. Priorities move here, and some processes are still being built. You will often be the person building them. What You Bring Experience as an HR Business Partner in a deep-tech or engineering-heavy company while it was growing fast. Something you built yourself. A performance process, a leveling framework, compensation bands. We will ask what you personally designed, what you would do differently, and what happened after rollout. Strong German employment law and GDPR, plus a working knowledge of People Operations, including how contract types and payroll deadlines shape a decision. Fluent German and English. Based in or near Darmstadt, or ready to relocate. The leaders you will work with are engineers. They respond to a precise question and a clear recommendation backed by evidence, and they notice quickly when either is missing. If that sounds like a room you enjoy, you will do well here. It helps if you have seen both a well-run large company and a scale-up, or have partnered with technical and scientific leaders before. What We Offer A competitive salary and stock options, so you hold a stake in what we build. A company contribution of 20% on top of your own payments into a private pension plan, plus loyalty incentives. 30 days of vacation. A mobility budget through NAVIT for public transport, car sharing or taxi, and access to gyms and studios across Europe through Wellhub. A canteen with daily lunch in Darmstadt, and the laptop and equipment of your choice from day one. A seat close to the leadership team, in a People function that is still being shaped. Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits. description: We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us. Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades. At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel. Customer Success at Duffel Customer Success owns Duffel's relationship with our customers once the contract is signed. We help them integrate, launch and grow on Duffel across Flights, Stays and more. The team brings together Customer Success Managers, Customer Success Engineers and Technical Support Engineers across London and New York, led by our VP, Customer Success. We're growing the team and building the processes that help customers go live faster and get more from Duffel. The Role We're hiring a Senior Project Implementation Manager to own every new customer's journey from signed contract to a live, transacting integration. This is a new, senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Customer Success, with a direct line of sight to the leadership team. You'll run each onboarding as a project with a plan, a date and named owners, working with our Solutions Engineer so customers go live on time and with the right setup for their proposition. You'll also hold the view across every onboarding in flight, give the leadership team a clear, regular read on progress and risk, and work with internal teams to remove friction, automate manual steps and shorten the time it takes customers to go live. Our customers include some of the largest fintech and software platforms in the world, building flights, stays and more on top of Duffel's API. Most of our transaction volume is in the US, so you'll work closely with US-based customer teams from London. What You’ll be doing: Own each onboarding end to end: take the handover from Sales at contract signature, run a structured kick-off, and lead the customer through to go-live and their first live bookings. Build and run a project plan for every onboarding, covering commercial setup, API integration milestones, payments and finance setup, testing and launch, and be the customer's single point of contact for status. Pull in the right people across Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, Engineering, Payments, Finance and Travel Operations, spot blockers early, and escalate when a date slips. Keep one source of truth for every onboarding in flight, prioritise across them, and report weekly to the VP, Customer Success and monthly to the leadership team. Build a repeatable onboarding playbook, track time-to-live, on-time go-live rate and time to first transaction, and feed recurring friction back to Product and Engineering. What we're looking for: 5+ years running customer onboarding, implementation or technical project delivery in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments or another API-first business, with a track record of getting several complex onboardings live on time at once. Enough technical fluency to follow API-led integrations (REST APIs, webhooks, sandbox vs production, test plans) and hold your own with engineers. You don't need to write code. Confidence with senior customer stakeholders, and calm, direct escalation: you raise a slipping date early, with a proposed fix and a named owner. Experience building process where little exists, such as a playbook, tracker or reporting cadence, and getting other teams to adopt it, plus clear written status reports a leadership team can read in two minutes. Willingness to work regular US-overlap hours. Experience in travel tech, onboarding enterprise platforms that embed a third-party API, or being the first person in a new function is a bonus. What you'll be working on In your first 30 days: getting to know every onboarding in flight, who's involved and where each one is stuck, with a single tracker in place and a first status report to leadership. By 90 days: every new customer gets a kick-off, a project plan and a committed go-live date, a v1 onboarding playbook is in use, and baseline time-to-live is measured. Designing the onboarding model by segment, from white-glove onboarding for large platforms to a lighter, scalable path for smaller accounts. In your first year: time-to-live measurably shorter, most onboardings going live on the date agreed at kick-off, and a playbook solid enough to hand to the next hire into the team. Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business. Perks That Actually Matter: ✈️ Travel Allowance: We literally pay you to get out of town and explore the world. 🏝️ Work From Anywhere: Flexibility is built in. Work remotely, or take advantage of our Sabbatical Policy. ⚡ Electric Car Scheme: Roll up in a brand-new EV with eco-friendly tax savings. ⚖️ Work-Life Harmony: Flexible bank holidays, generous family leave, and a dedicated volunteering day. 📚 Growth Tools: Paid study days to level up your skills, plus a solid pension and cycle-to-work scheme. 🏥 Health & Wellbeing: Private healthcare, eye test cover, and season ticket loans. 🏡 Family Leave (maternity, paternity and adoption) The Details 📍 Location: Shoreditch, London (Hybrid: In-office Tuesdays & Thursdays). 🧠 Interview Process: Simple & transparent: Talent Team Chat Hiring Manager Interview Technical Interview Final Stage Interview We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe that the key to our success is employing a diverse team, that's why recruitment decisions are only based on your experience and skills. We value your ability to problem solve and build amazing things so we welcome applications for everyone - regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief. Note to recruitment agencies Duffel does not accept speculative CV's from external parties. Any unsolicited CV's sent to us will be treated as property of Duffel, and any attached terms and conditions associated with these CV's will be null and void. description: Who are we? It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS! Tasks As our Senior Incident Response Consultant (m/w/d), you will support the NVISO incident response team (CSIRT) in responding to a wide range of cyber incidents. In addition to incident response and forensic engagements, you will work closely with the rest of the team to build & automate incident response processes, analytical capabilities, including threat hunting. You act as Incident Lead by setting investigative questions, delegating technical analysis tasks, and steer containment and eradication strategies. You produce high-quality forensic and executive reports to present findings to technical stakeholders and executives. You occasionally peer-review case notes, artifacts, and draft reports. Your responsibilities Perform host forensics (Magnet AXIOM Cyber, X-Ways, Autopsy), network forensics (Wireshark, tshark), memory forensics (Volatility, MemProcFS), and log analysis, including cloud telemetry (Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS, Google Cloud/Workspace), in support of cyber incident investigations. Lead single-system forensic analysis and contribute meaningfully to complex intrusions, including those with lateral movement, perform timeline analysis of compromised hosts and conduct live response artifact capture, volatile data collection, containment to support eradication and recovery efforts. Perform basic malware triage of executables and malicious scripts (static and behavioral) to inform containment and eradication strategies. Lead customer calls during incidents and contribute to cyber crisis management, and deliver status reports, planning for containment, eradication and recovery efforts, and input to executive-ready communications. Support improvement projects related to automation in digital forensics and further develop NVISO tools and incident response processes. Perform threat hunting engagements within customer environments, including technical planning, requirements definition, execution, and reporting. Assist in other engagements such as tabletop exercises, incident and forensic readiness assessments, and threat-intelligence-related briefings. Requirements You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states. 4+ years of hands-on experience, including acting as an incident response case lead. Strong knowledge of cyber intrusion analysis, incident response, digital forensics on Windows/MacOS/Unix, with demonstrated expertise in memory forensics (Volatility, MemProcFS), timeline analysis (e.g., MFTECmd, KAPE, Plaso/Timesketch), and disk forensics (Magnet AXIOM Cyber, X-Ways, Autopsy). Proficiency with live response tooling (e.g., Velociraptor, GRR Rapid Response, EDR live response) and coordinating remediation actions. Up-to-date on the latest cybersecurity threats and attacker TTPs. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail in documentation. Effective communication and interpersonal skills to work collaboratively with clients and cross-functional teams. Ability to remain calm during crisis situations and prioritize effectively under pressure. Language: German and English at C1+ proficiency for client-facing work across DACH. Your availability We have an On-call rotation, typically one week per month. Travel Some limited travel within DE/AT/CH (~10–20%) for onsite response, workshops, and stakeholder meetings. Benefits At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components: Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc); An entrepreneurial and agile company, where you will be stimulated and supported in driving new initiatives (either through internal innovation or by improving our service offering), without losing sight of having fun! Regular team-building and fun events; Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career! A training budget of 10,000 EUR plus 10 days paid time off rolling over two years; An annual gross base salary between 69,000 EUR and 87,000 EUR, depending on your experience; Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad options within the EU); Reimbursement of Deutschlandticket + BahnCard 50 1st Class; Business Bike Leasing; Company Pension Scheme; 30 holidays. Disclaimer on the Use of AI Tools in the Application Process Please be aware that the creation and submission of application documents (e.g. CV, cover letter, case studies, etc.) using AI-powered tools is only permitted to a limited extent. Our expectations: Application documents must authentically reflect your own qualifications, personality, and motivation. The use of AI for supportive purposes (e.g. spell-checking, improving wording) is acceptable. Fully generated application documents created by AI without personal adaptation or review are not permitted. Under no circumstances may NVISO information, data, or documents be uploaded to or processed by external AI tools. We reserve the right to exclude applications from the selection and interview process that are clearly created primarily or exclusively by AI and show no recognizable personal input. The purpose of this policy is to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process and to obtain an authentic impression of our applicants. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel. Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes. Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes. Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature. Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit. Ce qu'on va attendre de toi : Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes. Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive. Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique. Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles. Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu. Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit. About Frontier Faculty Frontier™ is a decision operating system. It puts AI to work on the decisions that matter most to large organisations, such as where to invest, how to allocate resources, and when to act. Every enterprise is investing heavily in AI, but few are confident it will improve performance. Too often it goes to what’s easy to automate, disconnected from the decisions that actually move the business. Frontier works backwards from objectives like revenue, margin and risk to the decisions that drive them, then connects the data, models and agents those decisions need into a world model of the business. Teams simulate and optimise options with ADA, our AI decision agent, and every decision is tracked against its outcome so the system keeps learning. Our ambition is to make business decisions as easy to navigate as getting around a city. We don’t believe in AI that thinks for people. We believe in AI that helps people think, with humans and agents working together inside a decision system. Customers start with one high-value decision and prove value in weeks.
