description: 1043 - Data Engineer (Neo4j/Cypher/Knowledge Graphs) · Semi-Senior · Remoto · Argentina Ubicación: Argentina Modalidad: 100% remoto Tipo de contratación: Relación de dependencia (full-time) Industria / Proyecto: LegalTech / Inteligencia Legal y Regulatoria con IA Zona horaria: Argentina (ART / UTC-3) Seniority: Semi-Senior (3 a 5 años de experiencia) Conocé Darwoft En Darwoft desarrollamos software que genera impacto real. Somos una compañía tecnológica latinoamericana que trabaja junto a empresas de diferentes partes del mundo, creando soluciones digitales innovadoras, escalables y de alto valor. Nuestra cultura combina excelencia técnica, colaboración, aprendizaje continuo y una fuerte orientación a las personas. La Inteligencia Artificial forma parte de nuestra manera de trabajar, innovar y resolver problemas. Buscamos incorporar nuevas tecnologías para construir mejores productos y potenciar las capacidades de nuestros equipos. Si te apasiona la tecnología, disfrutás resolver desafíos complejos y querés participar en proyectos donde tu trabajo tenga impacto, nos encantaría conocerte. Sobre el rol Estamos buscando un/a Data Engineer Semi-Senior con experiencia práctica en Neo4j, Cypher y modelado de datos en grafos para sumarse a un proyecto innovador de LegalTech enfocado en transformar la manera en que se organiza, conecta y consulta información legal, tributaria, contable y regulatoria. Vas a participar en el desarrollo y evolución de un Knowledge Graph que permitirá relacionar grandes volúmenes de información, identificar conexiones semánticas y potenciar soluciones de búsqueda inteligente basadas en Inteligencia Artificial. Esta posición combina Data Engineering, Graph Databases e Inteligencia Artificial, con un fuerte enfoque en la construcción de soluciones productivas, escalables y mantenibles. Trabajarás junto a equipos de Data Science, Backend e IA para transformar modelos conceptuales, taxonomías y ontologías en estructuras de grafos eficientes que alimenten arquitecturas de recuperación de información como RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Buscamos una persona con una base sólida en ingeniería de datos, experiencia real trabajando con Neo4j y motivación por seguir desarrollándose en Knowledge Graphs, búsqueda semántica y GraphRAG. ¿Qué vas a hacer? Modelado de grafos: Diseñar, implementar y mantener modelos de datos en Neo4j, representando entidades, relaciones, jerarquías y estructuras complejas de información. Ingeniería de datos: Construir y optimizar pipelines ETL/ELT para ingesta, transformación, validación y actualización de datos estructurados y no estructurados. Desarrollo con Cypher: Crear y optimizar consultas complejas para recuperación de información, navegación de relaciones y procesamiento de datos en grafos. Implementación de Knowledge Graphs: Transformar taxonomías, ontologías y modelos conceptuales definidos por Data Science en estructuras productivas dentro de Neo4j. Integración con IA y RAG: Participar en la integración de Neo4j con embeddings, búsqueda vectorial y arquitecturas de recuperación semántica. Optimización de performance: Mejorar consultas, estrategias de indexación, consistencia de datos y escalabilidad de la base de grafos. Integración con Backend: Desarrollar integraciones mediante Python o Node.js para conectar los datos del grafo con aplicaciones, APIs y servicios internos. Calidad de datos: Implementar validaciones, controles automatizados y buenas prácticas para garantizar la integridad y confiabilidad de la información. Trabajo interdisciplinario: Colaborar con especialistas en Data Science, Inteligencia Artificial y desarrollo de software para evolucionar la arquitectura de datos. ¿Qué buscamos? Experiencia: Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia profesional en Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering o posiciones similares. Neo4j: Experiencia práctica diseñando, implementando y manteniendo soluciones basadas en bases de datos de grafos. Cypher: Buen dominio del lenguaje para desarrollar consultas complejas, recorrer relaciones y optimizar operaciones sobre grafos. Modelado de datos: Conocimiento de modelos Property Graph, nodos, relaciones, labels, propiedades y buenas prácticas de diseño. ETL/ELT: Experiencia desarrollando pipelines de ingesta, transformación e integración de datos. Programación: Manejo de Python o Node.js para procesamiento de datos, automatización o integración con servicios. Optimización: Conocimiento de índices, constraints, optimización de consultas y performance de bases de datos. Arquitectura de datos: Capacidad para transformar requerimientos funcionales y técnicos en modelos de datos escalables y mantenibles. Fundamentos de IA: Familiaridad con embeddings, búsqueda semántica, bases vectoriales o conceptos de RAG. Autonomía y colaboración: Capacidad analítica, resolución de problemas, documentación técnica y buena comunicación con equipos interdisciplinarios. Será un plus Experiencia con Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG o arquitecturas de recuperación híbrida. Conocimiento de Neo4j APOC, Graph Data Science (GDS) o Neo4j Vector Index. Familiaridad con tecnologías semánticas como RDF, OWL, SKOS o SHACL. Experiencia integrando Neo4j con LangChain, LlamaIndex u otros frameworks de IA. Experiencia con Neo4j AuraDB, despliegues cloud o entornos contenerizados. Conocimiento de NLP, extracción de entidades, procesamiento documental o enriquecimiento semántico. Familiaridad con Kafka, RabbitMQ o herramientas de procesamiento distribuido. Experiencia implementando pruebas automatizadas sobre grafos, validaciones de calidad de datos o herramientas de observabilidad. Experiencia previa en proyectos de LegalTech, RegTech, compliance o plataformas de gestión de conocimiento. ¿Qué te ofrecemos en Darwoft? Contrato full-time en relación de dependencia con pago en ARS. Trabajo 100% remoto. Salario competitivo. Licencias legales y vacaciones. Días personales adicionales al año. Acceso a plataformas de aprendizaje. Tarjeta de beneficios y descuentos. Welcome kit. Programas de reintegros. Clases de inglés. Programa de referidos. Regalo de cumpleaños. Healthy Break. Celebraciones al estilo Darwoft: aniversarios, fiestas de fin de año, cumpleaños y actividades de integración. Conocé esta y otras oportunidades en: Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Signicatis a pan-European digital identity company that makes it easy and safe for organisations to know who they are interacting with online. Using our proprietary technology, we help companies and public organisations securely verify the identities of people and businesses, authenticate users, and enable compliant electronic document signing, so their customers can access services and complete online processes with confidence. Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale. Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world. About the Role Imagine a software development environment where AI agents can collaborate, plan complex tasks, write code, run tests, and help engineers turn ideas into working software. That's what we're building. As a Platform Engineer in Signicat's AI Foundations team, you'll help design and build our internal AI Software Factory: a platform that enables teams of autonomous AI agents to work together, interact securely with our systems, and accelerate how we build software. This isn't just about integrating LLM APIs. We're building the foundations for agent-driven software engineering, tackling challenges around orchestration, distributed execution, state management, sandboxing, security, and human-agent collaboration. Our platform runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes, with Go as our primary programming language. You'll join a team exploring the boundaries of what's possible with AI agents, combining experimentation with solid software engineering principles to turn ambitious ideas into reliable, production-ready systems. How You'll Make An Impact Build the AI Software Factory: Design and develop the core services, APIs, and infrastructure that enable AI agents to plan, execute, and collaborate on complex software engineering tasks. Orchestrate intelligent agents: Build systems that coordinate multiple specialized agents, manage dependencies, schedule work, and support long-running, asynchronous workflows. Design reliable agent runtimes: Develop secure, stateful execution environments that manage agent lifecycles, context, tool invocations, retries, recovery, and execution isolation. Make autonomous execution safe: Implement sandboxing, fine-grained permissions, and security boundaries that allow agents to interact with code, tools, and internal systems without compromising security. Connect agents to the real world: Integrate LLMs, development workflows, internal APIs, and external tools through secure, extensible interfaces and emerging standards such as MCP and A2A. Enable human-agent collaboration: Help create systems where engineers can guide, supervise, and collaborate with autonomous agents, maintaining control over important decisions. Shape the future of AI engineering: Evaluate emerging technologies, challenge existing approaches, experiment with new architectural patterns, and help define how autonomous software engineering evolves at Signicat. Solve interesting engineering problems: Apply your understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, fault tolerance, and software architecture to challenges that don't always have established solutions. Why We'll Love You You have strong software engineering experience, ideally with Go, and enjoy building robust backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. You're comfortable working with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure, ideally on Google Cloud Platform. You think beyond individual services and understand how to design systems that handle concurrency, failures, asynchronous execution, and complex state transitions. You care about clean architecture, well-designed APIs, maintainable code, and automated testing. You understand the importance of security, particularly around authentication, authorization, isolation, and executing untrusted workloads. You're curious about LLMs and autonomous agents, including concepts such as tool calling, context management, multi-agent collaboration, and agent orchestration. You enjoy exploring emerging technologies, experimenting with new approaches, and turning promising ideas into practical solutions. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership of challenging technical problems, and helping shape architectural decisions. You enjoy sharing knowledge, collaborating with others, and challenging assumptions to find better solutions. Bonus Points You've built systems using agent frameworks such as Google ADK, or worked with protocols like MCP or A2A. You have experience with sandboxing or workload isolation technologies such as gVisor, WebAssembly, or container-based execution environments. You've worked with event-driven architectures, workflow engines, distributed schedulers, or systems supporting long-running processes. You've experimented with AI coding agents, autonomous development workflows, or multi-agent systems. You have experience designing secure integrations with external services, including OAuth and delegated authorization. You've explored graph-based architectures, RDF, SPARQL, or event-driven systems, and are excited about using these concepts to model complex relationships, agent workflows, and dynamic, reactive applications. This is a wish list, not a checklist. You don't need to have worked with every technology or built AI agents before. If you're a strong engineer who loves solving complex problems and is excited about shaping the future of AI-driven software development, we'd love to hear from you. What we offer: Tailored benefits package by location - we aim to empower our employees by offering customised benefits suited to each market Your tech, your way - choose the tech gear that aligns with your comfort and meets your preferences Remote work style -while you embrace a remote environment, we support occasional in-person gatherings to strengthen the teamwork Work-life balance - enjoy an extra 5 paid days off annually, and we make sure to celebrate your work anniversaries to acknowledge the milestones you achieve Health & Wellness - we prioritise your physical and mental well-being by providing designated packs and access to the Headspace app Continuous growth - quarterly development talks, a dedicated time during working hours each week for training and development, access to Udemy courses, defined career paths, and internal mentorship opportunities Customised onboarding - we will prepare an Onboarding Plan to ensure an easy and smooth beginning Be part of an international team - the opportunity to work from any other Signicat office for 2 months per year and 3 weeks per year from any EU country Empowering feedback culture - by using employee engagement tools, we ensure that every voice is heard, empowering us to grow together Meet-ups - frequent office gatherings and biennial Kick-off event to bring every Signicat under one roof that you don’t want to miss Salary: €70,000-€90,000 gross yearly. We are open to discussing the salary based on your skills and competencies. Originally posted on Himalayas

As a global professional services leader, our focus remains on providing bespoke solutions that enable organizations to create the future of business and embrace change for sustainable growth, powered by a global team of over 5,000 people. Today, this extends to more than 1,500 enterprise clients, where the focus remains on creating systems that are not only functional, but ready to adapt and evolve over time. description: Ajax Systems ist ein internationales Technologieunternehmen und der größte Hersteller von Sicherheitssystemen in Europa mit über 4,5 Millionen Endnutzern und 330.000 PRO-Nutzern in mehr als 180 Ländern weltweit. Das Unternehmen bietet End-to-End-Lösungen zum Schutz von Wohn- und Geschäftsobjekten jeder Größenordnung. Bis heute umfasst das Produktportfolio von Ajax 280 Geräte für Einbruchschutz, Videoüberwachung, Brand- und Lebenssicherheit sowie Komfort- und Automatisierungslösungen. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt 5.000 Spezialisten. Wir bauen lokale Teams auf, weil wir davon überzeugt sind, dass lokale Experten die Besonderheiten ihres Marktes am besten verstehen. Ajax Systems ist weltweit mit Vertriebsmitarbeitern vertreten, unter anderem in Norwegen, Schweden, Dänemark, Finnland, Italien, Spanien, Deutschland, Frankreich, dem Vereinigten Königreich, den USA, Australien, Südafrika und weiteren Regionen. Das globale Business-Development-Team vereint Gleichgesinnte, die die ambitionierten Ziele von Ajax Systems teilen. Die Kombination aus erstklassiger Software und leistungsstarker Hardware hat die Wahrnehmung von Sicherheitssystemen für Anwender und Branchenexperten nachhaltig verändert. Durch Anerkennungen auf den größten Fachmessen wie IFSEC, Expoprotection und Intersec sowie durch den Gewinn renommierter Auszeichnungen führender Branchenmedien wie dem PSI Magazine und GIT SECURITY zählt Ajax heute zu den meistausgezeichneten Sicherheitssystemen Europas. Die Produktion von Ajax Systems umfasst vier Fabriken, davon zwei in der Ukraine, eine in der Türkei und eine in Vietnam. Gleichzeitig gewährleistet die ISO-14001-Zertifizierung des Unternehmens eine minimale Umweltbelastung durch die Produktion. Die Auswahl der Komponenten für die Herstellung der Ajax-Geräte basiert auf Herstellererklärungen, die die Einhaltung der RoHS-Richtlinien bestätigen. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und arbeiten Sie an Europas Sicherheitssystem mit den meisten Auszeichnungen mit! Intrusion, Video, Zutritt, Brand) Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder in der Unternehmensentwicklung in einem vertikalen B2B-Markt. Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau (in Wort und Schrift). Erkundung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Organisation von Treffen mit Geschäftspartnern. Planung und Vorbereitung von Präsentationen für Geschäftspartner und andere interessierte Personengruppen. Aufbau und Erhaltung von Beziehungen zu Kooperationspartnern und Leitstellen. Kommunikation von Produktfunktionen, Vorteilen und Entwicklungen an Geschäftspartner. Durchführung von Produkt- und Handelsschulungen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Geschäftspartnern. Aktive Förderung der Spezifikation von Systemen, die Produkte und Lösungen von Ajax Systems enthalten. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebspartnern von Markenprodukten, um die Anforderungen der Geschäftspartner zu erfüllen. Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von Marktstrategien für Produkte und Lösungen von Ajax Systems. Rückmeldung an das Management über die Anforderungen an aktuelle und zukünftige Produkte und Lösungen von Ajax Systems. Erstellen von genauen und zeitnahen Berichten unter Verwendung des CRM-Systems des Unternehmens zur Unterstützung der eigenen Aufgaben oder entsprechend den Anforderungen des Managements. Werden Sie Teil des Teams, das ein intelligentes und sinnvolles globales Produkt herstellt.

description: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business. Why This Role Matters Our GTM Analytics team owns the metrics that run the business for Sales, Marketing, and Client Success. We're past the phase of standing up basic reporting — we're now building a modern, agentic analytics practice, including Lighthouse, our internal BI-as-code platform, where dashboards, metrics, and semantic definitions live in version-controlled code rather than scattered across disconnected tools. This role is a chance to shape that next chapter. You'll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CS leaders to answer their hardest questions about pipeline, funnel conversion, campaign performance, and retention, while helping build the infrastructure and AI-forward workflows that let the whole GTM org get trustworthy answers faster. You'll report to our Senior Manager of Analytics and work in tight, two-week sprints alongside Analytics Engineering, so you'll see your work ship and get used — fast. What You'll Do GTM Analysis & Decision Support Deliver decision-ready analysis across Sales, Marketing, and Client Success: pipeline health, funnel conversion, campaign and channel performance, cohort/retention, and GRR/NRR drivers. Partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CSM stakeholders to scope questions, frame recommendations, and see analysis through to a decision — not just a dashboard handoff. Bring structure to ambiguous asks — translate a stakeholder's question into a clear, testable analytical approach. Data Modeling & Quality Build and maintain dbt models and marts for Sales, Marketing, and CS domains, with Salesforce as a core source system. Own data quality and documentation for your domain: clear definitions, source-of-truth tables, and QA that stakeholders can trust without double-checking. Lighthouse & Agentic Analytics Contribute to Lighthouse, our BI-as-code platform, as we build it out — help define how dashboards, metrics, and semantic models get written, versioned, and reviewed like software. Note: Lighthouse is an active build, not a finished platform — you'll be shaping it, not just using it. Push our analytics workflows toward agentic AI: using AI agents to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting, and cut down on manual, one-off dashboard requests. Bring a point of view on where AI can replace manual analyst work versus where it can't — you should be as comfortable prompting and evaluating an agent as writing the SQL yourself. How You'll Work Operate in two-week sprints, planning and prioritizing your own backlog against team OKRs alongside your manager. Give clear, proactive status updates to stakeholders rather than waiting to be asked. What We're Looking For Experience 5+ years in analytics/BI, with meaningful time supporting Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success functions at a fast-growing company. Staff-level candidates should bring deeper scope — larger or more ambiguous problems owned end-to-end, and a track record of setting technical direction, not just executing against it. Expert SQL and hands-on dbt experience modeling GTM data. Comfortable with Python for analysis and automation — this isn't a heavy ML/stats role, but you know how to script your way out of manual work. Experience with Salesforce as a data source — you understand CRM objects, fields, and the quirks of modeling data. Familiarity with a modern data stack: Fivetran or similar EL tooling, and a cloud warehouse (we run Snowflake; BigQuery experience also welcome). BI & AI Fluency Experience with at least one modern BI tool (Sigma, Hex, Tableau, Looker, or similar) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement — what matters more is that you understand how modern BI organizations operate: governed semantic layers, self-serve dashboards, and BI-as-code approaches. Genuine curiosity about agentic analytics — you've used AI agents or LLM tools to speed up analysis, and you want to help define what that looks like at scale. We build with Claude day-to-day, so hands-on experience with Claude Code (or a similar coding agent like Codex) is a big plus — you'll use it to move faster on dbt models, scripting, and analysis, not just as a novelty. Mindset Strong communicator who can frame a recommendation clearly for a non-technical stakeholder and defend it under questioning. Comfortable with the accountability of owning a deliverable through to closure, not just the analysis in the middle. Energized by ambiguity and fast iteration — two-week sprints mean you'll ship early and often. Compensation Additional Information Join us in shaping the future of real estate The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages. We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition. Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date. More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner. Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform. Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com. Who We Are: The Knowledge Graph Platform team builds the foundational systems that help Reddit understand entities, relationships, and context across its content. We are evolving an advanced, AI-powered knowledge graph into a reliable, scalable platform that enables teams across Reddit to build better experiences on top of shared, high-quality knowledge. This is a high-leverage team at the intersection of data, platform engineering, and AI. Our work supports emerging capabilities such as contextual grounding while creating the contracts, standards, and developer experience that make shared data dependable and easy to use. This team is strategically positioned to impact both ads and consumer roadmaps. Our data is used across ads marketplace models as well as user-facing features on reddit.com. What You’ll Do: Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers building Reddit’s Knowledge Graph Platform; create a high-trust, high-performing environment with clear goals and strong technical ownership. Set the technical direction and roadmap for a scalable knowledge graph platform, including data and API contracts, service interfaces, reliability, observability, performance, and developer experience. Leverage SOTA LLM and agentic patterns for knowledge graph construction. Establish production-grade operating standards: defining SLOs, implementing quality measures of data within the knowledge graph, governance mechanisms, and safe change-management practices. Partner with engineering, computational linguists, and domain-expert teams to define a shared operating model for ontology, data quality, governance, and platform evolution. Be a steward of data in the KG - ensure the graph has the coverage and freshness needed for priority use cases. Work with our dedicated data labeler team on shared goals around data coverage and quality. Work closely with internal product and engineering teams to understand their needs, prioritize high-value use cases, and increase access to the platform. Drive the next wave of graph-powered capabilities, including opportunities in shopping, search, ads marketplace models, consumer feed models. Stay close to architecture and technical design, helping the team navigate complex system tradeoffs and contribute hands-on when it is the highest-leverage path. Communicate the team’s strategy, priorities, risks, and progress clearly across a distributed, cross-functional organization. Who You Might Be: 8+ years of total software engineering experience, with 2+ years directly managing, coaching, and developing engineering teams. Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic or ontology systems, entity resolution, search, or contextual grounding is highly desired. Experience building or operating AI/ML powered, or data-intensive platforms, with a proven track record of leading shared technical systems with multiple internal customers. Strong understanding of how to turn a technical system into a product-like platform: setting an operating model with customers, establishing data or service-level contracts, useful documentation, and a path to self-service adoption. Experience establishing data contracts around quality, lineage, or governance. Strong technical judgment across distributed systems, backend services, data platforms, APIs, reliability, and operational excellence. Comfortable making technical and product tradeoffs in ambiguity, including when a dedicated product manager is not present. Excellent collaborator and communicator who can earn trust with engineers, senior leaders, and partner teams across time zones. Enjoy building clarity and durable operating mechanisms where ownership and processes are still evolving. Excel in evangelization and driving platform adoption cross org. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). Nice to Have: Master’s or Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Linguistics, or a related field. Location: This role is 100% remote (US & Canada only) and will regularly meet with teams in the EU and the US. Candidates based in ET timezone will be given preference to accommodate team schedules. Perks and Benefits: 100% remote opportunity (we have 4 office locations for hybrid/onsite work preference in NY, SF, LA and Chicago) Competitive salary and equity options Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision) & workplace perks (home office set up stipend etc) Generous 401k matching Flexible vacation policy Paid parental leave (4+ months) Family planning support Paid volunteer time off #LI-AS1 Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/. To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below. description: About the Role Mercury is seeking a Business Continuity Management (BCM) Lead to build and lead an enterprise-wide continuity program as we prepare to become a bank. As part of the Risk team, this leader will establish practical standards, clear accountability, and tested capabilities to maintain critical services and recover effectively from disruptions, with direct visibility to the CRO and senior leadership. This role fills the need for a dedicated leader to coordinate BCM across the organization. The ideal candidate combines deep continuity and resilience expertise with the judgment to build a proportionate program in a fast-moving environment, working effectively with Engineering, Operations, Product, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, and business teams. The BCM Lead will own the enterprise framework, coordination, oversight, and reporting. Business and technology owners will remain accountable for their continuity plans and recovery execution.Because this is a new program, the Lead will be hands-on in the initial build: facilitating the first round of BIAs and plans side by side with owners, running exercises, and driving identified gaps through remediation. This leader will also work closely with Engineering on technology disaster recovery and with relevant teams on incident response, crisis management, and third-party resilience. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement Mercury’s enterprise BCM framework, policies, standards, governance, and operating model, with a prioritized implementation roadmap aligned to bank-launch readiness and critical services. Partner with business owners to identify critical services, conduct business impact analyses (customer, financial, operational, and regulatory), and map dependencies across people, processes, technology, facilities, and third parties, including single points of failure. Establish recovery time objectives (RTOs) and recovery point objectives (RPOs), where applicable, with business and technology owners; challenge gaps between objectives and recovery capabilities. Set standards for continuity plans and recovery procedures, and facilitate and support accountable owners in developing actionable plans and alternative operating arrangements. Coordinate business continuity with technology disaster recovery, incident response, and crisis management, with clear activation criteria, escalation paths, and communications responsibilities. Design and lead a risk-based exercise program, from tabletop simulations to end-to-end recovery tests, and drive lessons learned, remediation tracking, and verification that gaps are closed. Partner with Third-Party Risk Management and vendor owners to assess critical provider recovery capabilities, contingency arrangements, and concentration dependencies. Embed continuity considerations into new products, material business changes, and technology implementations. Establish metrics and reporting that give management and relevant committees visibility into readiness, testing outcomes, material gaps, and overdue remediation. Build and lead a growing BCM team, including hiring and developing analysts as the program scales over the next year. Deliver role-based training and promote awareness of continuity responsibilities across the organization. Support regulatory examinations and bank-launch readiness reviews with accurate documentation and evidence of recovery capability. Qualifications 10+ years of experience in business continuity management, operational resilience, disaster recovery, or a related discipline within a fintech, financial institution, technology company, or other highly regulated environment. Demonstrated experience building or materially enhancing an enterprise BCM program, including governance, implementation, testing, and reporting. Strong skills in business impact analysis, critical-service identification, dependency mapping, and recovery objective development. Experience developing actionable continuity plans and leading exercises that test recovery assumptions and expose gaps. Sufficient technical fluency to work with Engineering on cloud services, system dependencies, data recovery, and technology disaster recovery. Working knowledge of third-party risk management, including assessing critical vendor recovery capabilities, contingency arrangements and concentration risk. Proven ability to drive cross-functional remediation through influence, with a clear view of where BCM oversight ends and business or technology ownership begins. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain readiness gaps and tradeoffs to senior leadership. Experience managing a team of Business Continuity analysts. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with banking supervisory expectations for business continuity, and operational resilience. Experience operating in a company-building or bank-building environment. Familiarity with recognized continuity standards, such as ISO 22301, and BCM tools for plan management, exercises, and issue tracking. Relevant professional certification, such as CBCP or MBCI. Leadership Attributes Pragmatic, first-principles builder who turns ambiguous needs into clear priorities and designs a program that fits Mercury’s operations and scale. Takes ownership and follows through from identified gaps to demonstrated recovery. Collaborative, low-ego, and effective across the three lines of defense. Calm under pressure and able to facilitate clear decisions during disruptions. Able to challenge constructively, distinguish material gaps from theoretical concerns, and avoid over-engineering. *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC. Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. #LI-DR1 Total Rewards The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits. Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers. Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following: US employees in New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area: $163,000—$203,800 USD US employees outside of New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area: $146,700—$183,400 USD Canadian employees (any location): $154,100—$192,600 CAD

description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As an Intermediate Software Engineer on GitLab’s Vulnerability Management team, you’ll help build the core security workflows that GitLab Ultimate customers use to triage, prioritize, and act on vulnerabilities. You’ll work primarily in Ruby on Rails on backend systems, including security dashboards, vulnerability reports, and ingestion pipelines. You’ll take ownership of well-defined projects, solve technical problems with support from experienced team members, and collaborate with other engineers. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute beyond the backend when the work requires it. You will join a fullstack team, working together with product managers, designers, and frontend engineers to solve problems across the Vulnerability Management domain. What you’ll do Develop and maintain backend features for GitLab’s vulnerability management workflows. Confidently ship features and improvements with minimal guidance and support from other team members; collaborate with the team on larger projects. Help improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of security data ingestion and reporting systems. Collaborate with frontend engineers and contribute across the stack when needed. Work with engineers across security teams as vulnerability data and workflows come together in Vulnerability Management. Collaborate with Product Management and Product Design to maintain a high bar for quality Craft code that meets our internal standards for style, maintainability, and best practices for a high-scale web environment Conduct code reviews within our Code Review Guidelines and ensure community contributions receive a swift response Recognize impediments to our efficiency as a team ("technical debt"), propose and implement solutions Participate in on-call rotations to assist troubleshooting product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues. What you’ll bring Experience building and maintaining backend applications with Ruby on Rails. Experience delivering and maintaining software systems as part of a larger engineering team. The ability to investigate technical problems, ask for context when needed, and work toward a practical resolution. Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL. Clear communication and collaboration skills in a distributed team. An interest in learning from others, sharing knowledge, and growing your technical skills. Frontend development experience, including JavaScript or Vue.js, is helpful. Experience with Elasticsearch, graph databases, vulnerability management, application security, or related transferable skills is helpful. About the team The Vulnerability Management team develops the core security workflows that help GitLab customers triage and manage vulnerabilities. The team owns areas including the security dashboard, vulnerability reports, and ingestion pipelines, and serves as an important interface for security-related features across GitLab. The team is focused on moving beyond lists of findings toward workflows that help customers prioritize and coordinate remediation. You’ll collaborate asynchronously with a small, distributed group and with related security teams, including the Agentic Security Flows team. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us. GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. description: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development. We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there. If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you! Job Overview The Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) independently performs, coordinates and oversees clinical site monitoring activities, ensuring compliance with study protocols, Alimentiv and sponsor procedures, ICH-GCP guidelines and local regulatory requirements. Serving as a primary liaison between investigative sites, Alimentiv and sponsors, the Sr. CRA plays a key role in the successful execution of clinical studies from site selection and start-up through monitoring and close-out. This role also provides guidance and mentorship to CRA I and CRA II colleagues and may participate in CRA assessment visits, co-monitoring activities, audits and inspections. Key Responsibilities Independently conduct and document onsite and remote site management activities, including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits, in accordance with applicable SOPs and study requirements. Serve as a primary point of contact for investigative sites, building effective working relationships and ensuring site questions, issues, action items and protocol deviations are followed through to resolution. Review source documentation and study systems to ensure clinical data is accurate, complete and compliant with protocol, regulatory and study requirements; manage and facilitate the resolution of data queries. Oversee site activation and ongoing site management activities, working with sites and cross-functional teams to achieve project timelines, milestones and recruitment objectives. Ensure site personnel are appropriately trained on study protocols, plans, systems, ICH-GCP requirements and project-specific expectations. Routinely review Investigator Site Files (ISF), Trial Master Files (TMF) and study systems for accuracy, completeness, timeliness and compliance, requesting outstanding documentation as required. Coordinate site-related study activities and communications, including clinical supplies, investigational product, laboratory materials, ePROs, study documentation and ongoing project updates. Collaborate with Study Start-up, Regulatory and other cross-functional teams, including supporting document collection, localisation and translation activities where required. Participate in study meetings, Investigator Meetings, audits and inspections, supporting issue resolution and implementation of corrective actions when required. Mentor and support CRA I and CRA II colleagues, including CRA Assessment Visits, co-monitoring and sign-off activities; contribute to CRA interviews, training and process improvement initiatives as requested. Skills & Qualifications (Honours) Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in Health Sciences, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or Nursing is preferred. A Master’s degree is considered an asset. Minimum 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience; 7–9 years of related experience is preferred. Experience across Phase I–IV clinical trials is preferred. Thorough knowledge of ICH-GCP and applicable local regulatory requirements. Demonstrated experience independently conducting site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits. Proficiency with clinical trial systems including EDC platforms (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm), IRT, eTMF and CTMS, as well as Microsoft Office. Strong interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively within cross-functional teams. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage priorities with an appropriate sense of urgency. Fluent written and verbal English; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered. Valid driver’s licence and ability to travel approximately 40–60%, depending on project assignment and the geographic location of investigative sites. What We Offer In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs: Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility) One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.) Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year! Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition! Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team! Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility. Our Services End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading Precision medicine and biomarker solutions Real-world evidence and clinical consulting Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio How to Apply To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English. Equal Opportunity and Accessibility Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com. Compensation Additionally: Annual Bonus (Short Term Incentive Program) target = 8% of annual salary A monthly stipend of 400 RON (pro-rated based on hours of work), to be paid with their regular payroll/added to their taxable income. This is intended to offset the business use of the employee’s communication costs (internet, VoIP, land line, etc.) Monthly Cell phone stipend (RON 50) A one time expense reimbursement of up to 500.00 (local currency) to purchase other office items such as a scanner/printer, an extra monitor, office furniture and supplies, etc. Mileage reimbursement for travel Additional Information Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process. Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and web services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing pre-IPO international software company. Canonical’s engineering team is at the forefront of the IoT revolution and aims to strengthen this position by developing cutting-edge telemetry and connectivity solutions. By integrating reliable, secure, and robust data streaming capabilities into the Snappy ecosystem, we are setting new standards in the industry for ease of development, implementation, management and security. We are seeking talented individuals to help us enhance our global SaaS services, providing customers with the essential data services needed to build the next generation of IoT devices effortlessly. Our commitment to data governance, ownership, and confidentiality is unparalleled, ensuring our customers can innovate with confidence on top of the globally trusted Ubuntu platform. Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region. What your day will look like Work remotely with a globally distributed team, driving technical excellence and fostering innovation across diverse engineering environments. Design, architect, and build high-performance APIs to power streaming data services, ensuring seamless integration across teams and products using Python and Go. Develop robust governance, auditing, and management systems within our advanced telemetry platform, ensuring security, compliance, and operational integrity. Partner with our infrastructure team to build scalable cloud-based SaaS solutions while also delivering containerized on-prem deployments for enterprise customers. Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of new features, taking projects from specification to production, ensuring operational excellence at scale. Provide technical oversight, review code and designs, and set best practices to maintain engineering excellence. Engage in high-level technical discussions, collaborating on optimal solutions with engineers, product teams, and stakeholders. Work remotely with occasional global travel (2-4 weeks per year) for internal and external events, fostering deeper collaboration and knowledge-sharing. What we are looking for in you You design and architect scalable backend services, messaging/data pipelines, and REST APIs using Go or Python, guiding best practices, technical direction, and system scalability. You possess deep expertise in cybersecurity principles and proactively address the complex challenges of IoT environments: secure connectivity, data streaming, governance, and compliance. You bring proven expertise in designing and optimizing systems using: IAM models, encryption, access control, and compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) to ensure secure and compliant data handling Ability to design decentralized data ownership models, ensuring interoperability and governance across domains Designing high-throughput, low-latency systems for IoT data processing Data streaming technologies (MQTT, Kafka, RabbitMQ) Observability tools (OpenTelemetry) Industrial/engineering data exchange protocols (OPC-UA, ModBus) You thrive in cross-functional environments, partnering with product teams, engineers, and stakeholders to drive high-impact technical solutions that align with business objectives. You mentor junior engineers, foster technical excellence, and contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. You embrace challenges with an open mind, continuously seeking opportunities to learn, improve, and innovate in a rapidly evolving IoT landscape. You are familiar with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM, or a related field. You are willing to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events. What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #LI-remote

description: About Keyfactor Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor! Title: Enterprise Sales Account Executive, Federal (formal title is Sales Director, Federal) Location: United States, Washington DC Metro Area (Remote) Experience: Senior Level Job Function: Sales Employment Type: Full-time Industry: Computer and Network Security About the position Keyfactor is seeking a Federal Sales Director to lead and grow our public sector business across U.S. federal civilian, defense, and intelligence agencies. In this role, you will own the federal go-to-market strategy for Keyfactor digital trust solutions, in your assigned territory. You will work as part of a high-performing federal sales team, develop strategic relationships with agency stakeholders, system integrators, and channel partners, and navigate the federal procurement landscape, including contract vehicles, compliance requirements, and long-cycle opportunities. You will be accountable for pipeline development, forecasting, and revenue attainment, and will work closely with Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Legal to position Keyfactor as a trusted partner in the federal market. The ideal candidate brings a proven record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder federal deals, deep familiarity with how agencies buy, and credibility with technical and executive audiences. Experience in cybersecurity, identity, or cryptography is strongly preferred. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Responsibilities • Understands and contributes to contract negotiations. • Delivers reliable forecasts and accurate reporting for the territory. • Collaborates with marketing to build out the go-to-market (GTM) strategy. • Manages pipeline over long sales cycles. • Develops new accounts while maintaining and sustaining successful long-term relationships with key decision-makers up to and including the C-level. • Contributes to the development of product, market, and competitor knowledge. • Participates in events and tradeshows. • Maintains a commitment to the company’s sales processes, values, and target visions. Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Technology, or equivalent experience. • Strong understanding of IT security, PKI, and certificate lifecycle management. • In-depth knowledge of market dynamics and competitor strategies. • Familiarity with regulatory requirements in the IT Security industry. • Experience with and knowledge of MEDDPICC, Solution Selling, and SPIN Selling. • Ability to develop and execute strategic direction aligned with company goals. • Proficient in using advanced sales tools and technologies. • Ability to identify and develop opportunities for future business growth, including strategically important partnerships and key customers. • Ability to coach others and share knowledge, insights, and skills with the broader team. • Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Compensation Salary will be commensurate with experience. Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special: Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce. We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary: As an Enterprise Sales Executive on Toptal’s Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI) team, your mission is to win new enterprise clients. You will build your own pipeline, open doors into financial institutions where Toptal does not currently do business, develop opportunities, and close new commercial engagements. This is a pure hunter role for accomplished sales professionals who thrive on creating opportunities, competing for business, and turning new relationships into signed deals. You will lead the end-to-end new-client acquisition process, from identifying target accounts and engaging decision-makers to shaping solutions, negotiating commercial terms, and securing new business. Working in close partnership with our Client Partners, you will ensure a seamless transition from acquisition to account growth, maintaining strategic alignment throughout the handoff. This collaborative model allows you to focus on what you do best: building relationships, opening new doors, and winning new business, while Client Partners drive ongoing account management and expansion. We are looking for exceptional business developers who combine deep BFSI industry expertise, executive credibility, and consultative selling skills with the urgency, persistence, and competitive drive of a true hunter. You understand the business and technology challenges facing banks, financial services organizations, and insurers, and know how to translate those challenges into compelling commercial opportunities. You leverage your industry knowledge and relationships to navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, engage senior decision-makers, and create demand where none exists. You take ownership of your results, thrive on winning new clients, and do not wait for opportunities to come to you. Financial institutions are navigating significant change, from modernizing legacy technology and operating models to adopting AI, improving customer experiences, managing risk, and driving greater operational efficiency. At Toptal, you will bring together our capabilities across technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent to help clients address these challenges and accelerate their most important initiatives. You will have access to exceptional delivery expertise, industry leadership, and a global talent network, giving you the flexibility to shape solutions around what clients actually need. Success in this role is measured by new enterprise logos acquired and new business booked. This is a high-accountability, high-reward opportunity for individuals who want direct ownership of their commercial results and the opportunity to build a substantial business through their own efforts. This is a remote position with an expectation of regular client-facing engagement and field activity. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. You will be responsible for building and converting a pipeline of net-new enterprise clients across the Banking, Financial Services & Insurance industry. You will identify high-potential organizations, develop access to decision-makers, uncover business challenges, and create opportunities for Toptal to compete and win. You will lead the sales process from initial engagement through securing the first revenue booking, working closely with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders to shape compelling solutions, navigate complex buying processes, and close new business. Your focus is exclusively on acquiring new clients. You will not inherit an existing book of business or carry ongoing account management and expansion responsibilities. Once new clients are signed, they transition to Client Partners and the appropriate delivery teams. Hunt and win new enterprise clients. Own new-logo acquisition and secured bookings across banking, financial services, wealth, capital markets, and insurance organizations, with direct accountability for identifying, developing, and closing new business. Build your own pipeline. Proactively identify target accounts, develop prospecting strategies, leverage your BFSI industry network, and create new opportunities through consistent, disciplined outreach. Partner with SDRs to accelerate prospecting without depending on them to generate your pipeline. Open doors at the executive level. Establish relationships with senior business and technology leaders, economic buyers, and key decision-makers within financial institutions where Toptal does not have an established commercial relationship. Create demand and shape opportunities. Engage prospective clients around their strategic priorities, identify business problems worth solving, and position Toptal’s capabilities in ways that create compelling reasons to act. Bring informed perspectives on the challenges and opportunities shaping the financial services industry. Lead and close complex sales pursuits. Own the full sales cycle, including qualification, discovery, stakeholder alignment, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, procurement, contracting, and close. Compete and win. Develop winning strategies to displace incumbent providers, differentiate Toptal from traditional consulting and technology services firms, and navigate complex enterprise buying processes, including the risk, compliance, security, and procurement requirements common within financial institutions. Sell the full breadth of Toptal’s capabilities. Partner with Industry GMs, Sales Leaders, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, and Delivery teams to bring together specialized talent, technology, AI, consulting, and managed services solutions that address client needs, from technology modernization and digital transformation to operational improvement and AI-enabled innovation. Maintain a high-quality, self-generated pipeline. Build sufficient qualified pipeline to consistently deliver new-logo and bookings targets. Maintain accurate opportunity intelligence, forecasting, and disciplined sales execution. Take ownership of commercial outcomes. Drive opportunities forward with urgency, navigate obstacles, negotiate effectively, and remain personally accountable for securing the business. Execute clean client transitions. Ensure signed agreements, commercial commitments, and relevant client context are transferred to Client Partners and delivery teams, allowing you to return your focus to new-client acquisition. Build a strong market presence. Spend time in front of prospective clients, developing relationships through executive networking, BFSI industry events, referrals, and direct engagement. We are seeking people who enjoy the hunt as much as the win. You should be energized by breaking into new accounts, creating opportunities from scratch, and closing business that would not exist without your efforts. In the first week, expect to: Onboard with Toptal, learning our business model, value proposition, and capabilities. Familiarize yourself with our sales methodologies, prospecting tools, and commercial processes. Understand our BFSI industry strategy, target client profiles, priority segments, and markets. Meet the Industry, Sales Development, Pursuits, and Delivery leaders who will support your success. Become familiar with our contracting, legal, and commercial processes. In the first month, expect to: Develop a targeted new-logo acquisition plan with your BFSI Industry GM and Sales Leader, identifying priority accounts, executive buyers, and initial pursuit strategies. Begin actively prospecting into new banking, financial services, and insurance accounts, leveraging your existing industry relationships while building new ones. Establish a consistent cadence of outbound activity, executive outreach, and new-business development. Coordinate with SDRs to expand target-account coverage and accelerate opportunity creation. Begin discovery conversations with prospective clients and build your initial qualified pipeline. Develop a strong understanding of how to position Toptal’s technology, AI, consulting, managed services, and talent capabilities against the priorities and challenges facing BFSI organizations. In the first three months, expect to: Establish a measurable pipeline of qualified net-new BFSI enterprise opportunities, including a meaningful contribution from your own prospecting and relationship development. Build relationships with economic buyers and senior decision-makers across priority target accounts. Lead active sales pursuits, working with internal experts to develop differentiated solutions and competitive proposals tailored to financial services clients. Demonstrate the ability to qualify, advance, and close opportunities through complex enterprise buying processes, including financial services-specific security, compliance, and procurement considerations. Secure initial new-logo wins and bookings, building momentum toward your commercial targets. Maintain an accurate, well-managed pipeline with clear next steps, close strategies, and forecasts. In the first six months, expect to: Establish a track record of acquiring new enterprise BFSI clients and securing commercial commitments. Build and sustain a healthy pipeline of new-logo opportunities sufficient to support continued bookings performance. Demonstrate consistent self-sourced opportunity creation alongside effective use of SDR and cross-functional support. Successfully navigate competitive pursuits, executive negotiations, procurement, risk reviews, and contracting to close business. Demonstrate the ability to move from one successful acquisition to the next, maintaining momentum without becoming involved in ongoing account management. Show measurable progress against defined new-logo and bookings targets. In the first year, expect to: Consistently deliver against new-logo acquisition and bookings expectations. Establish a repeatable, high-performing approach to originating and closing new enterprise business across BFSI. Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified new-logo opportunities through direct prospecting, executive relationships, industry referrals, and coordinated business development. Build a reputation as a highly effective hunter and closer who can create opportunities, navigate complex financial services buying environments, and win competitive deals. Develop a network of executive relationships and market connections across BFSI that supports continued new-client acquisition. Be recognized for your industry knowledge, commercial judgment, competitive drive, personal accountability, and ability to deliver measurable new-business results. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is required. 7–10+ years of demonstrated success in enterprise new-business development and sales, ideally within consulting, technology services, professional services, or managed services. Extensive experience selling into Banking, Financial Services, Wealth, Capital Markets, and/or Insurance organizations with a demonstrated understanding of industry dynamics, business priorities, and enterprise buying environments. Experience within one or more BFSI segments is required. A proven track record as a true new-business hunter. You have personally originated, developed, and closed enterprise clients rather than relying on inherited accounts, established relationships, or account expansion to deliver your results. Consistent achievement or overachievement of new-logo and new-business bookings targets, with the ability to demonstrate your individual contribution to pipeline creation and closed business. Demonstrated ability to build a territory and qualified pipeline from scratch, including direct prospecting, executive networking, account penetration, and competitive displacement. Experience originating and closing complex, high-value enterprise engagements, ideally with organizations generating $2B+ in annual revenue. Proven success selling consultative, service-oriented solutions involving technology, consulting, managed services, or other complex professional services offerings. Strong understanding of the challenges facing financial institutions including technology modernization, digital transformation, AI adoption, operational efficiency, customer experience, and evolving regulatory and risk considerations. Ability to engage credibly with C-suite executives and senior business and technology leaders within BFSI organizations, develop executive sponsorship, and navigate complex stakeholder environments. Strong business acumen and the ability to uncover client challenges, shape commercial opportunities, and translate business priorities into compelling solutions. Demonstrated success leading full-cycle enterprise sales pursuits, including opportunity qualification, solution development, competitive positioning, pricing, negotiation, procurement, and contracting. Experience navigating the complex procurement, legal, information security, risk management, and compliance processes associated with large financial institutions. Strong understanding of emerging technologies, including AI, and the ability to discuss their practical application to enterprise business challenges within financial services. Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to shape and win complex engagements while retaining personal ownership of the sales outcome. Strong commercial discipline, including pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, opportunity prioritization, and consistent execution. Resilience, persistence, competitive drive, and the ability to create momentum in environments where opportunities must be earned rather than provided. An entrepreneurial mindset, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment. We are looking for individuals who have built their careers winning business, not simply managing it. You should be able to point to the clients you personally brought in, the opportunities you created, and the deals you closed. You should be motivated by ambitious goals, meaningful financial upside, and the opportunity to compete and win. Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. Essential Job Functions Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera. Work independently with minimal supervision. Use all required digital collaboration tools. Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines. This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.
